source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: As the opponent’s [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) begins, you may have one of your army’s **PSYKER** models use Horrible Fascination. Choose an enemy unit the caster can see up to 12″ away and roll one D6. A 1 deals D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) to the caster. On 2–5 the target takes −1 on its [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) for the phase. On 6 the enemy unit becomes ineligible to shoot for that phase.
